paragraphs: I'm applying for the Associate Deployment Strategist role on the Future Platforms team for housing. I'm an MBA (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli in New York, and before school I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Taking an AI product from early customer promise to something a property team actually uses every day is the part of this role that pulls me in.

At Lenovo I documented business requirements and turned stakeholder needs into dashboards for campaign initiatives, which improved campaign ROI by 20%. I also owned the mapping and QA for AI-powered dashboards with real-time metrics, which cut reporting time by 4+ hours a week. At Thomson Reuters I worked in order-to-cash, where automating the process cut the cash conversion cycle by 20%, so I've seen up close what it takes for a new workflow to stick.

Scoping what a customer needs, keeping several workstreams moving and feeding what I learn back to product is work I'd enjoy owning. I'm happy to be in the office and to travel to clients. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
